title: P300 BCI EEG dataset (Chailloux Peguero et al. 2020)
description: A P300 brain-computer interface EEG dataset from 19 healthy participants recorded across 3 sessions each. The study examines how visual stimulation conditions, standard flash versus cartoon face stimuli, affect single-option P300-BCI performance across five grid sizes (4-9 symbols). Recordings use an 8-channel montage sampled at 256 Hz and include target and non-target event labels. This BIDS version was converted via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) and 8 passive g.SCARABEO electrodes at Fz, Cz, P3, Pz, P4, PO7, PO8 and Oz (10-20 system), sampled at 256 Hz with a right earlobe reference and AFz ground. The P300 paradigm used two stimulus types (standard flash and cartoon face) across grid sizes of 4-9 symbols, with a 75 ms inter-stimulus interval and 150 ms stimulus onset asynchrony.
